freshArchiveAudit.scope: All four current sealed ZIPs streamed to EOF per file with CRC, whole-file SHA, duplicate/traversal/private-name checks and bounded known secret/developer-path byte patterns including native binaries. Exact fixed upstream fixture only. Completeness/metadata checks use fresh archive hashes and bound scans. No extraction, daily state scan or source modification; no assertion of arbitrary-secret absence, full source-to-native rebuild reproducibility, macOS/Linux release readiness or all-plugin runtime compatibility.

unchangedProgramEvidence.interpretation: Previous content-level evidence retained for identical program graph and Update ZIP; these were not all rerun after document-only packaging. Counts overlap and must not be summed into unique feature coverage.
